title: Automated Cinematic Asset Generation for Digital Marketing
business: Digital marketing agencies producing high-volume video content for social media campaigns.
problem: Manual video editing and keyframe interpolation for short-form content is labor-intensive, causing bottlenecks in campaign deployment and increasing production costs.
solution: The Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash model provides native video generation and keyframe interpolation capabilities, allowing agencies to automate the creation and extension of visual assets with synchronized audio.
steps: Define the base video segment and target duration for the campaign asset.
Configure the Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash endpoint to receive the source video input.
Invoke the model to perform keyframe interpolation to smooth transitions between existing frames.
Extend the video duration using the model's native generation capabilities to meet specific social media format requirements.
Validate the output for visual consistency and audio synchronization.
outcome: Increased production velocity and reduced manual editing overhead for short-form video assets.
limitation: The model may occasionally produce temporal artifacts during complex keyframe interpolation; developers should implement a visual validation step to check for frame-to-frame coherence.
